title: Digital Marketing Team Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a
 **Digital Marketing Team Lead** 
 to oversee daily operations and ensure the team remains aligned. This individual will engage with team members daily to resolve blockers and maintain clarity regarding their specific KRAs and KPIs. Given that Munim manages 2 products: Billing \& Accounting Software and GST Return Filing Software\- the ideal candidate must possess a solid understanding of accounting, GST, and finance. This foundational knowledge is essential for the role, as this person will serve as the final reviewer for all content and campaigns before they are deployed.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Check in with every team member, every day. Catch problems early and clear blockers fast.
* Set clear KRAs and KPIs for each role, explain them simply, and make sure everyone can repeat back what they're accountable for.
* Review KRA/KPI progress weekly or bi\-weekly and course\-correct when someone's off track.
* Plan, prioritise and drive campaigns across SEO, paid ads, social, content and email.
* Be the bridge between the team and management. Pass things down clearly, bring feedback and blockers back up.
* Make sure content, ad copy and campaigns are built on facts, not assumptions. Loop in Product whenever needed.
* Track and report performance (traffic, leads, conversions, ROI, spend) to leadership on schedule.
* Guide and upskill the team. Spot training gaps and close them.
* Own the digital marketing budget and manage vendor/agency relationships.


**Requirements**
* Real understanding of accounting, GST \& basic finance, or a background in that field (Must)
* 5\+ years in digital marketing, including 3\+ years leading or coordinating a team.
* Solid hands\-on experience with SEO, paid ads (Google/Meta), social, content and email marketing.
* Comfortable setting KRAs, KPIs or OKRs and holding people accountable without micromanaging.
* Strong daily communication. Someone who can run a check\-in that actually unblocks people, not just collect status updates.
* Data\-driven. Comfortable reading dashboards and using numbers to make calls.
* Has worked closely with product or sales teams before to keep marketing content accurate.

description:

title: Chief Growth Officer
description:
**Chief Growth Officer, VERDICT** 




  





**SVECTOR** 
 · Full\-time · Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (On\-site)
 



  





**About the role** 




 VERDICT is SVECTOR's product for talent decisions: leadership hiring, enterprise assessment, and volume hiring. Right now it runs on founder conviction. This role exists to test that conviction against real buyers and turn it into a business that doesn't need the founder to close every deal.
 



  





**The mandate** 




 Convert founder belief into tested market evidence: who pays, why, how much, how urgently. Then build the pricing, positioning, and playbook that make VERDICT repeatable, not one relationship's worth of revenue.
 



  





 This is not a Head of Sales role. If it were about meetings booked and calls made, it would carry that title. This role is accountable for whether VERDICT becomes a business.
 



  





**What you'll own** 




 Not sales alone. The whole commercial system: acquisition, pricing, positioning, retention, expansion, and deal design.
 



  




* Run early discovery personally, before there's a finished product or case study to lean on
* Personally close the first customers, then document what worked so it can be taught
* Decide when founder involvement changes the odds of closing, and use that leverage sparingly
* Forecast honestly: what's likely, what's possible, what isn't happening without a specific change
* Negotiate for value, not just price: trade concessions for term length, references, or faster payment
* Understand VERDICT well enough to sell it without a script and to push back on product or pricing with market evidence



  





**Who actually fits this** 




 We're not looking for activity. We're looking for someone who gets real energy from building something out of nothing, and who can prove they've closed before, not just supported the process.
 



  




* You've personally originated and closed enterprise deals, and carried a number you were directly accountable for
* You've negotiated pricing and terms with senior buyers, not just relayed a quote
* You've navigated procurement, legal, or multi\-stakeholder buying and gotten the deal signed anyway
* You'd rather prove one repeatable motion than chase five directions at once
* You write clearly enough to move a deal forward by email and proposal, not calls alone



  





**This won't work if** 



* You measure your own success by meetings booked or pipeline size rather than closed, quality revenue
* You need a finished product, complete pricing, and a lead list before you can sell
* You'd route every deal through the founder rather than owning it
* You're looking for a big team or title on day one. Both are earned here, not granted upfront



  





**Location and terms** 




 Ahmedabad, full\-time, on\-site, with regular travel to customer and strategic\-account locations. Compensation combines a fixed component with variable pay tied to commercial outcomes. Structure and any long\-term value participation are set out in the offer based on experience and demonstrated capability.
 



  





**How we'll evaluate you** 




 A first screening round, followed by a conversation with the hiring lead, a written case assessment, and a final conversation with our Founder\-CEO, SDS.

title: National Business Head -Sales, Marketing and Government Business
description:
**NATIONAL BUSINESS HEAD – MEDICAL DEVICES \& HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY** 




**Company:** 

 EL\&EL Industries Pvt. Ltd.
 




**Location:** 

 Ahmedabad, Gujarat \| Extensive travel across India
 




**Reporting to:** 

 Managing Director / Founders
 




**Function:** 

 National Sales, Marketing, Distribution \& Institutional Business
 



**ABOUT EL\&EL** 


 EL\&EL Industries Pvt. Ltd. is an emerging Indian medical technology company focused on advanced surgical devices, medical equipment, minimally invasive surgery solutions, sterilization and infection\-control systems, and allied healthcare technologies.
 




 With a strong and growing business in Gujarat, EL\&EL is now entering its next phase: building a structured, scalable pan\-India presence.
 



 We are looking for a
 **National Business Head** 
 to lead this expansion and build the commercial organization required for EL\&EL’s next stage of growth.
 



 This is a hands\-on business\-building role. The person will be expected to build markets, recruit teams, appoint distributors, develop hospital and institutional relationships, establish systems and deliver measurable revenue growth.
 


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 

**1\. PAN\-INDIA EXPANSION \& SALES** 




 • Develop the national expansion strategy and state\-wise roadmap.
 



 • Prioritize markets based on potential, competition, customer opportunity and channel availability.
 



 • Set revenue targets, manpower requirements, distributor plans and timelines.
 



 • Design the national sales structure and recruit regional, zonal, state and territory teams.
 



 • Define KRAs, territories, targets and accountability systems.
 



 • Conduct field visits, joint customer calls and performance reviews.
 




 • Build a strong second line of leadership.
 




**2\. DISTRIBUTOR \& CHANNEL DEVELOPMENT** 




 • Identify, evaluate, appoint and develop distributors across priority markets.
 



 • Negotiate commercial terms, territory rights, targets, payment terms and stock commitments.
 



 • Evaluate partners on market reach, financial strength, hospital relationships, sales/service capability and compliance.
 



 • Track distributor productivity, secondary sales, inventory, customer activation and collections.
 



 • Manage channel conflict, discounting and inactive partners.
 



**3\. HOSPITAL \& INSTITUTIONAL BUSINESS** 




 • Develop business with corporate hospitals, hospital chains, medical colleges, surgical centres and other healthcare institutions.
 




 • Build relationships with surgeons, clinicians, biomedical teams, purchase departments and hospital management.
 




 • Drive the sales cycle from demonstrations and clinical evaluations through quotations, purchase orders, installation, training and repeat business.
 



 • Develop key hospital accounts and clinical opinion\-leader relationships.
 



 • Coordinate with application, service, regulatory, operations and manufacturing teams.
 



**4\. GOVERNMENT \& TENDER BUSINESS** 




 • Build EL\&EL’s government and institutional business across India.
 




 • Develop opportunities with Central and State Government institutions, government medical colleges, public hospitals, defence healthcare institutions, ESIC and other eligible buyers.
 




 • Drive business through government tenders, GeM, e\-procurement, rate contracts and procurement bodies.
 



 • Establish tender intelligence and opportunity tracking.
 



 • Coordinate bids with regulatory, finance, legal, service and operations teams.
 



 • Monitor profitability, payment cycles, execution obligations and receivables.
 



 • Ensure all government business is conducted ethically and in compliance with applicable laws.
 



**5\. COMMERCIAL SYSTEMS, MARKETING \& GROWTH** 




 • Implement a standardized sales pipeline and disciplined CRM usage.
 



 • Establish regular business reviews and improve forecast accuracy.
 



 • Build dashboards for revenue, margins, collections, pipeline and channel productivity.
 




 • Own national sales targets and contribute to the commercial P\&L.
 




 • Maintain pricing, margin and collection discipline.
 




 • Coordinate demand forecasting with manufacturing, procurement and inventory teams.
 




 • Develop recurring revenue through consumables, accessories, service contracts and repeat business.
 



 • Develop marketing programs including product launches, clinical workshops, training, conferences, exhibitions and digital initiatives.
 



 • Ensure marketing generates measurable opportunities.
 



**6\. LEADERSHIP \& CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL MANAGEMENT** 





 • Build a culture based on ownership, integrity, accountability, teamwork and execution.
 





 • Set clear expectations and measurable KRAs.
 





 • Encourage realistic forecasting and transparent reporting.
 





 • Develop future managers and leaders.
 




 • Work closely with Founders and cross\-functional teams.
 



 • Ensure customer commitments are commercially and operationally deliverable.
 


**KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS** 

 The role will be measured through:
 




 • National revenue and YoY growth
 





 • Gross/contribution margins
 




 • New customer acquisition, repeat and consumable revenue
 



 • Collections and receivable ageing
 




 • Priority states activated
 





 • Active and productive distributors
 




 • Sales\-team recruitment and productivity
 




 • Pipeline quality and forecast accuracy
 





 • Demonstration\-to\-order and quotation\-to\-order conversion
 




 • Government and tender business
 




 • Key hospital accounts and clinical relationships
 




 • Marketing and market\-development ROI
 


**IDEAL CANDIDATE** 


 •
 
**10–20 years** 

 of relevant experience in medical devices, surgical equipment, hospital equipment, healthcare technology, capital equipment or related healthcare businesses.
 




 • At least
 **5 years in a senior regional, zonal or national sales leadership role.** 





 • Proven experience expanding business across multiple Indian states.
 




 • Experience building and managing geographically distributed sales teams.
 




 • Strong distributor and channel\-management experience.
 





 • Experience selling to hospitals, surgeons, purchase departments and biomedical teams.
 





 • Meaningful exposure to government tenders, institutional business and public\-sector procurement.
 




 Experience in
 **surgical devices, minimally invasive surgery, operating\-room equipment, sterilization/infection control, medical capital equipment, surgical consumables or aesthetic medical devices** 
 is an advantage.
 



**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field. MBA/postgraduate qualification in Sales, Marketing or Business Management is preferred but not mandatory. Strong business performance and execution will carry greater weight than qualifications alone.
 


**THE LEADER WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 

 We are looking for a hands\-on leader who spends meaningful time in the market, converts discussions into actions and orders, provides realistic forecasts, takes ownership of problems and builds systems that can scale beyond individual relationships.
 


**FIRST\-YEAR MANDATE** 


 Within the first 12 months, the National Business Head will be expected to:
 



1. Review EL\&EL’s current Gujarat business, product portfolio, pricing, channels and sales capabilities.
2. Develop a pan\-India expansion plan covering priority states, revenue, manpower, distributors and timelines.
3. Establish sales leadership and market coverage across priority regions.
4. Build and activate a high\-quality distributor network.
5. Implement national CRM, sales\-review and forecasting systems.
6. Build a structured government and institutional\-business pipeline.
7. Develop relationships with major hospital groups, government institutions, surgeons and clinical opinion leaders.
8. Deliver agreed revenue, margin and collection targets.
9. Build a disciplined and ethical sales culture.
10. Create a scalable commercial organization for EL\&EL’s national growth.


**WORKING CONDITIONS** 


 • Full\-time leadership position based in/around Ahmedabad.
 





 • Extensive travel across India is an essential part of the role.
 





 • Regular customer, hospital, distributor, government and field\-team engagement is expected.
 





 • Performance will be reviewed against defined quarterly and annual objectives.
 




**If you are a hands\-on healthcare sales leader who has built markets, teams and channels and are ready to build a national business from the ground up, we would like to hear from you.**

**Solar**

Perform Data Analytics through Monitoring metrics and using tools like Google Analytics to measure performance and return on investment.

description:
**About the Company** 




  





 We require candidates ONLY from Textile Manufacturing units dealing specifically in Unstitched Fabrics, with strong hands\-on market knowledge in the following product lines:
 



  




* Suiting Range (including Cotton/Polyester Suiting)
* Shirting Range
* Digital Print Fabrics



  





 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat (with 12 to 15 days of travel per month \- Pan India)
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 KEY ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
 



  




* Experience: Minimum 9–10 years in Unstitched Fabric sales/marketing
* Industry: Textile Manufacturing (Suiting / Shirting / Digital Print Fabrics) only



  





 Experience Required: 15 / 20\+ years in textile sales, marketing, and business development (suiting \& shirting preferred). Minimum 8 / 10 years in a senior / leadership role managing teams, channels, and P\&L. Strong network across domestic textile trade (distributors, dealers, retailers, brands). Proven experience in scaling sales, building teams, and entering new geographies. Hands\-on understanding of fabric product categories, market trends, and buyer behaviour.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* **Sales Strategy \& Revenue Growth**
* Develop and execute a comprehensive sales and distribution strategy aligned with the company’s growth targets.
* Set and own aggressive but realistic sales targets across regions, channels, and product categories. The goal is to maximise sales output.
* Identify and capitalise on growth areas – both in terms of product (new fabric categories, blends, finishes) and geographies (underserved or high\-potential markets).
* Drive pricing strategy in coordination with management. Understand margin structures, competitive pricing, and trade schemes that move volumes without eroding value.
* Improve order forecasting accuracy over time. This is critical \- better forecasting means better production planning, lower inventory holding, and fewer missed deliveries. The management expects this to become a real strength of this role with time.
* 
* **Market Intelligence \& Trend Reading**
* Read the market continuously \- geographically, by product, by buyer segment. Understand what’s trending, what’s fading, what the competition is pushing, and where company can differentiate, etc.
* Get structured feedback from the market on product quality, pricing, design preferences, and service levels. Bring this back and discuss with management and the product/design teams so the company’s offering stays relevant.
* Must understand buyers and their purchase patterns. The market is changing with traditional wholesale models being disrupted by D2C brands, e\-commerce aggregators, and digitally savvy retailers. This role must stay on top of how buying behaviour is evolving.
* Track competitor moves \- new launches, pricing changes, distribution expansion and recommend proactive responses.
* 
* **Distribution \& Channel Management**
* Align and restructure distribution networks to improve reach and market penetration across India.
* Strengthen relationships with existing distributors and dealers. Build new, high\-potential channel partnerships where gaps exist.
* Implement effective trade schemes, incentives, and pricing structures that drive volume while protecting the company’s margin position.
* Lead market expansion initiatives across key regions. Identify spaces and build a phased entry plan.
* 
* **Team Building, Leadership \& Culture**
* Build, lead, and develop a marketing and sales team that operates with ownership, discipline, and pride in the company.
* The thinking here is not just to fill positions but to build a team where there’s real team binding and attachment to the work and to the company. People should want to stay and grow here.
* Handhold and train team members on products, fabric knowledge, selling techniques, and customer engagement. Be present and invested in their development.
* Set clear expectations. Review performance regularly. Reward strong performers and address underperformance with fairness and firmness.
* Must be a team player and team\-driven.
* 
* **Market Presence \& Brand Reputation**
* Actively represent a company in the market. Build and maintain relationships with trade partners, key accounts, and industry bodies on a foundation of integrity and trust.
* Uphold and enhance company’ reputation in the market. Every interaction with a customer or channel partner should reinforce the brand’s standing for quality, reliability, and fair dealing.
* Attend trade shows, exhibitions, and industry events. Use these platforms to strengthen the brand and build the pipeline.
* Engage with key accounts personally. For large or strategic accounts, this person should be the face of the company.
* 
* **Order Management \& Delivery Coordination**
* Monitor the entire order pipeline \- new orders, pending orders, production scheduling, dispatch status and ensure timely delivery against commitments.

**About Shipturtle** 




 Shipturtle is a fast\-growing SaaS platform helping businesses launch and scale multi\-vendor marketplaces. Our technology powers marketplaces across Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, and other commerce ecosystems, enabling brands to expand through collaborative commerce.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a growth\-oriented SaaS SEO professional who understands how organic traffic translates into pipeline, demos, and revenue.
 



 This is not a traditional SEO role focused only on rankings. We want someone who can connect keyword research, content strategy, technical SEO, user intent, and conversion optimization into a cohesive growth engine.
 



 You should be comfortable working across the entire organic growth funnel, from identifying opportunities to creating content strategies, improving website performance, analyzing results, and uncovering new growth channels.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Drive organic growth through a combination of SEO, content, and conversion optimization initiatives.
* Identify high\-intent keyword opportunities that generate qualified leads and demo bookings.
* Create and optimize landing pages, comparison pages, use case pages, solution pages, and educational content.
* Improve rankings, click\-through rates, engagement metrics, and conversion rates across existing content.
* Work closely with content, product, design, and development teams to execute growth initiatives.
* Conduct technical SEO audits and collaborate with developers to resolve issues.
* Analyze search behavior, customer journeys, and content performance to uncover growth opportunities.
* Build scalable content frameworks, topic clusters, and organic acquisition strategies.
* Support customer marketplaces with SEO recommendations, audits, and growth insights.
* Convert successful experiments and customer outcomes into case studies, playbooks, and repeatable growth processes.
* Track and report on key metrics including traffic, demos, pipeline contribution, and customer acquisition.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 3 years of experience in SEO, content marketing, growth marketing, or a related role.
* Strong understanding of technical SEO, on\-page SEO, content strategy, and analytics.
* Ability to connect organic traffic efforts to measurable business outcomes such as leads, demos, signups, or revenue.
* Experience working across multiple areas of SEO rather than a single specialization.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a growth mindset.
* Comfortable using tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or similar platforms.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Curiosity to experiment, learn, and identify new growth opportunities.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Experience working in SaaS, marketplaces, eCommerce technology, or B2B software companies.
* Exposure to content\-led growth and product\-led growth strategies.
* Experience with programmatic SEO, AI\-assisted content workflows, or large\-scale content operations.
* Understanding of Shopify, marketplace ecosystems, or commerce platforms.
* Experience working directly with customers and providing growth recommendations.



  





**Success in This Role** 




 Within the first 6–12 months, you will:
 


* Increase qualified organic traffic.
* Improve demo bookings and pipeline contribution from organic channels.
* Build scalable SEO and content growth frameworks.
* Help both Shipturtle and its customers achieve measurable organic growth outcomes.

This role owns marketing and communications for the district portfolio end\-to\-end from brand positioning and go\-to\-market strategy through to launch campaigns, PR, and on\-ground activations. Its presence across 15 domestic ports in seven maritime states of Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu and Odisha presents the most widespread national footprint with deepened hinterland connectivity. The port facilities are equipped with the latest cargo\-handling infrastructure which is not only best\-in\-class, but also capable of handling the largest vessels calling at Indian shores.  Provide superior customer service by analyzing and verifying order information promptly, implementing corrective actions as needed to uphold high service standards and customer satisfaction.

 Follow up on payments and support the business development of assigned commodities, ensuring timely collection of receivables.
 



**Market Promotion \& Engagement:** 




 Actively promote port services through direct presentations and maintain regular contact with customers, participating in industry events, trade shows, and conferences to enhance visibility and market presence.
 



**Strategic Monitoring and Feedback:**

**Operational Coordination:** 




 Facilitate smooth customer transactions by coordinating with Operations, Vessel Agents, Suppliers, Surveyors, CHAs, Finance \& Accounts, and CAD departments.

 Keep up with digital and AI advancements to enhance business and maintain competitiveness.

 Promote a respectful and safe workplace, lead collaborative and productive teams, and mentor for growth and success.

 CEO \- Ports, Other Departments \- HoDs, Direct reportees

 Prospective clients, government and regulatory bodies, Trade groups, Competitors

 MBA/PGDBA in Marketing or Manufacturing or Ports/Shipping \& Logistics
 



**Work Experience:** 




 Minimum of 5\-8 years of experience in Customer Service in Ports, Shipping or Logistics is essential.

description:
**Job Summary** 





 We are seeking a results\-driven and analytical HubSpot Email Marketing Expert to take the lead on our email marketing strategies and execution. This role demands deep hands\-on experience with the HubSpot platform to develop, implement, and optimize campaigns that drive engagement, generate leads, and foster customer retention. The ideal candidate will blend strategic thinking with technical proficiency to ensure every email aligns with our brand voice and achieves measurable business results.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Strategy \& Execution:** 

 Develop and implement an overall email marketing strategy and messaging framework using HubSpot
* **Campaign Management:** 

 Plan, build, and execute end\-to\-end email marketing campaigns, including newsletters, promotional offers, lead nurturing sequences, and automated triggered messages.
* **HubSpot Optimization:** 

 Manage and optimize our HubSpot portal, including workflows, automations, contact/company segmentation, and CRM with ERP integrations.
